description: What can psychology teach us about political attacks and public trust? Michelle Schreiner reflects on persuasion, caricature, and raising the standard of political disagreement.

title: We Can Disagree Better: Political Attacks, Psychology & Trust | Dr. Michelle Schreiner — Michelle Schreiner is a candidate for Georgia House District 45, rooted in East Cobb and focused on steady leadership, practical solutions, and real progress for Georgia families.
